_about: Flow inventory: the user journeys worth testing in each feature, which /qa coverage measures automation against. Key = catalog slug. level: e2e (this suite) | db (a business rule the HALDEN_DB_RULES oracle checks after every test) | api (test lower) | manual. A test covers a flow when it carries the tag flow:<ID>; a testplan.md case covers it when its Flow column names the ID and its status is Automated. IDs are stable for life; new flows take the next number. Built 2026-11-25 from the shop's documented rules (agents/personas.ts SHOP_CONTEXT, utils/shop-data.ts) and the existing suite. Change it only after the user confirms.

flows.name: Guest finds a product by browsing a category and opens its page
